title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak on 25.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 25/11/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25.11.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 25/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25.11.2026 ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak would not be
available for Judicial work.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi) would take up the
matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court (Coram :
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia and Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak.)
(3) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia would sit Single and
take up the matters at Sr. No. 116 to Sr. No. 166 notified
before the Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha
P. Mayee.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
